title: Optimal low-rank compression of quantum dynamics
summary: Local quantum interactions generate dynamics in an exponentially large Hilbert space, yet locality and entanglement restrict the information that can spread and accumulate. Bounds on propagation and entanglement growth, together with tensor networks, exploit these restrictions to discard information unnecessary for describing the evolution. This leads to a sharper question: how much information must any low-rank representation retain? Here we determine these limits, up to logarithmic factors, for short-range interactions.
